clinicalSources.title: Medsafe — NSAIDs and acute kidney injury

caption: NSAID inhibition of prostaglandins can reduce support for filtration during dehydration.
question: Why can an NSAID precipitate kidney dysfunction in a dehydrated patient?
answer: Reduced prostaglandin synthesis weakens afferent vasodilatory support when perfusion is already vulnerable, so filtration can fall.
